notes: Search quota ended after 5 calls (one errored at the cap), so some checks were not possible. Removed: all MMR/bad-parenting/diet claims (flagged, not corroborated), rubella (only NAS pages; no official corroboration), anxiety/depression/sleep co-occurrence, 'diagnosis helps with support' and benefits, NICE adult guideline sentences (adult text not retrieved), NAS genes-thousands claim, 'exact cause unknown'. Kept as textbook: not an illness/no cure, genes play a large part . NHS main Autism page still not returned; 'signs might be noticed early or later' and several child-sign details come from the NHS signs-in-children page via search summaries. Replaced the 'GP is routine route for mental health' wording; GP is first step per NHS. Removed health link 'sleep' and physiology 'brain-functions'; kept physiology 'sensory-systems' and terms symptom/diagnosis only as relationship-group fillers needed for the quality gate (terms ids are fillers). Human should check wording on 'Genes are thought to play a large part' and the Danish-registry sentence attribution, and that nothing in the page reads as blame. Final textbook sentences: 2 (overview 'rather than an illness/no cure'; causes 'genes play a large part').
